answer: The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The toll is a waiting period of 30 days that no payment can shorten per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Tinbound timberman rise seal sees to it, since a seal timbermen renew after gallery checks. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One ripple, one entry. The clerk notes velvet. Every sable is counted once.
